operations.description: List the project groups the caller owns (every project group for the admin)
Get a project group, checked on `srn:project-group:<project_group_id>:*`
Update a project group's name and owner policies, checked on `srn:project-group:<project_group_id>:*`
Delete a project group holding no project (admin only)
Create a project in a project group, checked on `srn:project-group:<project_group_id>:project/*`
Add a project to a project group (admin only)
Remove a project from a project group (admin only)
